text:
maria: Quick intake — new model 'lyra-8k-compact' landed from the catalog. Need quant plan + calibration. Constraints: target p50 latency ~80ms on 8xA100, cost <= ~60% of fp16, tolerate <=1.0% QA EM drop. Can we propose int8 and fp8 experiments and a gguf packaging path?
sanjay: SGTM. My proposal: staged experiments — 1) hybrid int8 (keep out_proj fp16), 2) fp8 e4m3 baseline for quality, 3) gguf packaging with per-channel static scales. Run sensitivity on MMLU, QA dev, and a few production prompt clusters.
ben: I'll own calibration runs. Need calibration sets: 2k prompt tokens, ~500 mini-batches sampled from prod prompt sampler. Any PII?
maria: no PII in the sample — anonymized. Add acceptance criteria: MMLU drop <=0.7% and avg answer similarity >=0.95 (embedding cosine vs fp16). Cost improvement >=40% vs fp16. If fails, fallback to optimized fp16 profile.
eval-bot: scheduled job created: /jobs/quant-calib-2398765432 tags=[lyra-8k,int8,fp8,gguf] ETA=6h :rocket:
ben: quick note — this model is KV-cache heavy. Test seq-lens 2048 and 8192. For int8 watch KV accumulator overflow; recommend per-layer clip and histogram checks.
sanjay: quant config sketch:
```
quant:
  mode: hybrid-int8
  out_proj: fp16
  per_channel: true
  activation: asymmetric
```
Also run rounded-LLM evals and the gguf roundtrip check.
maria: priority order: 1) int8-hybrid (fast win), 2) fp8-eval (quality), 3) gguf-embed-check (packaging). Ben, start int8 first.
ben: starting int8-hybrid run now. logs: "calib: 0/500 batches, out_proj skipped for FP16" — ping if it errors.
ops-bot: resource reservation confirmed — 8xA100-80GB reserved for 6h for job quant-calib-2398765432.
maria: if int8 meets quality gates, we'll canary 10% staging traffic using rollout policy canary-quant-lyra. Also add hallucination check.
sanjay: add hallucination harness: threshold <= +2% halluc rate vs fp16. Include BLEU/ROUGE deltas and exact-match deltas in the report.
ben: noted. Will upload artifacts at /artifacts/lyra/2398765432: calib.json, metrics.csv, gguf.tar.gz, diff_report.html.
maria: tagging @kevin for rollback playbook visibility.
kevin: got it — I'll add a preflight sanity check and canary rollback hook to the deployment plan.
ben: one more — if int8 fails on seq=8192 due to kv overflow, try block-quant for KV + retain fp16 for KV layers.
maria: perfect. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
